leads.summary_original:
INE counted 49,699 residents of foreign nationality out of 100,470 in Torrevieja on 1 January 2025, or 49.5%, the highest share of any municipality in the province with more than 50,000 residents. The Costa Blanca guide compares it with the other coastal towns. The figure counts nationality, not country of birth.

We publish no rent or property price for Tor
